claims.statement: Seven exploratory customer interviews are complete.
The business should charge an annual family subscription.
The clearest offer may be a one-time family archive purchase.
Keep public sharing out of the beta.
What earns enough trust for a family to upload its first voice recording?

decisions.title: Keep the beta private by default
decisions.decision: No public profiles, feeds, or open sharing links in the beta.
decisions.rationale: Privacy is central to the promise and public mechanics add risk before the core recording loop is proven.

decisions.title: Adult child is the launch buyer
decisions.decision: Design onboarding and acquisition around the adult child who starts the family archive.
decisions.rationale: This person feels the urgency, coordinates relatives, and is most likely to pay.

decisions.title: Choose the commercial model
decisions.decision: Annual subscription versus one-time archive remains unresolved.
decisions.rationale: The product creates ongoing value, but the customer may perceive the job as finite.

decisions.title: Set the beta success threshold
decisions.decision: A decision-grade beta needs 20 families, 12 with repeat recording, and 8 with a second contributor.
decisions.rationale: Activation alone is not enough; repeat capture and collaboration are the core behavior hypotheses.

artifacts.title: Business thesis
artifacts.summary: The strategic case for Storywell and the choices that keep it focused.

sections.title: Thesis
sections.body: Families want the voices and stories of older relatives, but the work feels emotionally and technically difficult. Storywell can win by making the first interview feel easy, private, and worth repeating.

sections.title: Initial wedge
sections.body: Adult children initiating guided interviews with a parent or grandparent after a milestone, health scare, or family-history trigger.

sections.title: What we will not build yet
sections.body: A public social network, genealogy database, automated memoir publisher, or generic podcast editor.

artifacts.title: Primary customer brief
artifacts.summary: The buyer, trigger, anxieties, and first-value requirement.

sections.title: Primary customer
sections.body: An adult child who lives apart from a parent or grandparent and feels that important stories are at risk of disappearing.

sections.title: Trigger moment
sections.body: A health scare, birthday, move into care, family reunion, or recent loss in the wider family creates urgency.

sections.title: Anxieties
sections.body: Making the conversation feel forced, asking the wrong questions, losing the recording, and asking an older relative to learn complicated software.

artifacts.title: Beta product brief
artifacts.summary: The first-value path and deliberately narrow beta scope.

sections.title: Promised outcome
sections.body: Save one meaningful family story in less than 15 minutes, then make the next conversation easier to start.

sections.title: Core loop
sections.body: Choose a prompt, invite or call a relative, record, review the transcript, save it to the family archive, and schedule the next prompt.

sections.title: Beta scope
sections.body: Guided prompts, recording, transcription, private archive, family invitations, contributor permissions, and lightweight reminders.

artifacts.title: Beta launch brief
artifacts.summary: The launch audience, proof threshold, milestones, and unresolved blockers.

sections.title: Launch cohort
sections.body: Twenty families recruited through trusted caregiving and family-history communities.

sections.title: Proof threshold
sections.body: At least 12 families record twice and 8 add a second contributor within the first 14 days.

sections.title: Blockers
sections.body: Commercial model, privacy language, account recovery, elder-friendly participation flow, and a precise support promise.

activity.title: Pricing assumptions conflict
activity.detail: Strategy suggests a one-time archive while the business model assumes annual subscription.

activity.title: Beta kept private by default
activity.detail: Public profiles, feeds, and open links were removed from the launch scope.

activity.title: Customer brief moved back to draft
activity.detail: New evidence weakened confidence in the current trigger-moment assumption.

activity.title: Interview evidence added
activity.detail: Seven exploratory interviews are now attached to the customer workstream.
